title: From Mixing to Tearing: Graph Decomposition in Decentralized Optimization via Message Passing
summary: We study decentralized minimization of sums of smooth strongly convex functions, one per agent, with communication restricted to neighbors in a graph. Existing decentralized algorithms typically emulate a {\it centralized} method; {\it the network serves only to exchange information}, from which agents approximate the global quantities that the method needs. This paper breaks with this paradigm. We introduce a {\it graph decomposition framework} that uses the network to design the method, not merely execute it. It jointly determines how agreement is imposed, which variables are optimized…
